insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Hapad US generated $17,589 in total sales for Week 46 on 1209 units, with organic revenue growing +5.6% WoW to $11,884. The Posting Heel Wedge was a standout at $1,075 (+35.6%) with a 52.2% conversion rate, and the Metatarsal Pad 3/8" Large 6-Pair Pack grew to $2,193 (+7.9%). Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $3,155.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales eased -4.4% WoW from $18,402 as PPC revenue moved to $5,705 (-20.2%). The Metatarsal Pad 5/16" Medium 6-Pair Pack, our top seller, came in at $4,427 (-12.8%), and the 1/4" Small 6-Pair Pack softened to $871 (-47.4%) with conversion at 11.4%, so we are focusing on bringing both back to their recent run rate.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend came down to $2,462 (prior $3,251) while ROAS improved to 2.32x from 2.20x and TACoS dropped to 14.0% from 17.67%. ACOS sits at 43.2%, with a healthy 0.84% ad CTR and 20.82% ad conversion rate, showing tighter spend is landing on higher-intent shoppers.

**Actions This Week —** We will lift bids on the Medium 6-Pair Pack's best-converting search terms to recover its volume, and expand targeting for the Posting Heel Wedge to capitalize on its 52.2% conversion. We will also refine campaigns for the Small 6-Pair Pack and keep trimming low-converting terms to bring ACOS below 43.2% as we head into the holiday season.
